text:
sam (Support): Fwding request from ACME Labs ticket #ACM-12345.
sam (Support): They want two models added to the catalog and made available in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1: `mosaicml/mpt-7b-instruct` and `EleutherAI/gpt-j-6B`.
sam (Support): Primary ask: hosted availability + region pinning for data residency. Also asked about version pinning and quantized variants.
nate (Sales): Context: ACME plans to roll this into a product feature. Initial forecast ~200M tokens/month, spikes to 1.5k QPS during batch jobs. Timeline: 4–6 weeks if possible. They're sensitive to latency and cost.
elaine (PM): Thanks — a few clarifying Qs: 1) target p95 latency SLO? 2) must the models be pinned to a specific commit/version? 3) do they require dedicated capacity or will hosted suffice initially?
sam (Support): Reply from ACME: p95 target ~300ms for 512-token responses, they asked to pin `mpt-7b-instruct@v1.2.3` and gpt-j standard release is fine, prefer hosted to start, but will consider reserved if we provide committed discounts. Compliance: EU data residency required.
li (ML Eng): Notes: we need the exact model artifacts and a representative prompt suite for evals. `mpt-7b-instruct@v1.2.3` likely needs kernel tweaks for 4-bit quant (Q4_0) — does ACME accept a quantized variant if it meets perf/quality? Also need to run our eval harness (latency, output quality, regressions) — estimate 3–5 workdays to bench both in eu region.
vikram (Runtime Eng): FYI APAC infra currently has fewer A100 pools; memory footprint for mpt-7b unquantized ~30GB. For Q4_0 we can fit on T4-like nodes but need kernel support. Rollout plan suggestion: 1) host Q4_0 in eu-west-1 (can meet residency), 2) run staged traffic with canary routing, 3) expand to ap-southeast-1 if benchmark passes. Also: fallback policy to a lower-cost variant if capacity tight.
elaine (PM): Proposed triage/outcome:
- Priority: P2 (customer-driven, revenue but not blocker)
- Backlog epic: "catalog: region availability for mpt-7b/gpt-j (ACME)"
- Acceptance criteria (must be met before GA):
  * models available in eu-west-1 hosted catalog with pinned version for mpt-7b
  * perf profile published (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec) for standard prompt set
  * quality checks: no regressions vs baseline evals (precision on ACME prompts)
  * quantized variant (Q4_0) validated with <5% quality delta and lower cost
  * documentation updated (region, SLA, costs, fallback behavior)
  * telemetry: cost & token breakdown visible in Console for ACME token keys
- Scope negotiation: roll out hosted variants first; Dedicated/Reserved only after ACME commits > $X/month or if latency cannot be met by hosted.
- Owners: li -> bench + evals, vikram -> runtime + kernel changes, docs -> product docs (assign later), elaine -> PM tracking
- Target ETA: 6–8 weeks (bench + infra + docs)
eli (sic) (note): tagging for follow-up and rough estimate requested from eng teams.
nate (Sales): Sounds good. Can we get a rough engineering estimate (dev + infra) to share with ACME during presale? Also want to cc them on the acceptance criteria once we lock it.
elaine (PM): I'll pull estimates after li/vikram quick sync. Plan: I will create the backlog epic and link ACME ticket. cc @sam to confirm the prompt set and expected traffic shape.
ticket-bot: Ticket #ACM-12345 linked to epic RED-4982 and jira ticket RED-4983.
sam (Support): Thanks — I'll send the prompt set and confirm the monthly commit thresholds with ACME now. :thumbsup:
vikram (Runtime Eng): Quick note — if we need a specific quant kernel, expect a 2-week dev + 1-week validation item. Adding to rough estimate.
elaine (PM): OK closing triage for now. Action items: li run bench (3–5d), vikram scope kernel work (2wk if needed), elaine create epic + docs stub, sam send prompt set. Reopen if ACME changes constraints. :white_check_mark:
